div.head: IV Eg 1.8
div.ab: ⁊ ic ⁊ mine þegnas wyldan ure preostas to ðan þe ure saula hyrdas us tæcað, þæt syndon ure bisceopas, þe we næfre mishyran ne sceolon on nan þara ðinga þe hi us for Gode tæcað, þæt we ðurh þa hyrsumnysse, þe we heom for Gode hyrsumiað, þæt ece líf geearnian, þe hy us towemað mid lare ⁊ mid bysene godra weorca.

And that I and my thegns shall enforce upon our priests the duties prescribed for us by the guardians of our souls, namely our bishops, whom we ought never disobey in any of these matters which they, as representatives of God, precribe for us, so that we, through the obedience which we show them as representatives of God, may inherit the eternal life to which they draw us by their teaching and by the example of good works.

⁊ ic ⁊ mine þegnas wyldan ure preostas to ðan þe ure saula hyrdas us tæcað, þæt syndon ure bisceopas, þe we næfre mishyran ne scylon on nan þara þinga, þe hy us for Gode tæcað, þæt we þurh þa hyrsomnysse, þe we heom for Gode hyrsomiað, þæt éce lif geearnian, þe hy us towemað mid lare ⁊ mid bysene goddra weorca.
